scope: Miao Chapter 16 (pp. 529-557): the Samuelson exchange OLG economy (offer curve, monetary and autarky steady states, Examples 16.1.1-16.1.2, Propositions 16.1.1-16.1.3, Pareto optimality and Balasko-Shell in the stationary case), the Diamond production economy (saving, the map G, steady states, stability, golden rule and dynamic inefficiency), Tirole bubbles, and Exercises 1-9.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 16
